documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported strong Q1 FY27 performance with revenue of INR3,637 million and a 120% increase in EBITDA to INR1,039 million. Management highlighted the success of their dual-casting model in the U.S. and the expansion of their lab-grown diamond jewelry business. The company is actively scaling its retail brand, ORIGEM, with plans to open 7 additional stores before Diwali. Management expressed confidence in maintaining growth momentum in the B2B segment through new customer additions and product category expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve double-digit growth in non-American regions by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: So we hope to increase that number in a good way by the end of the year. So we'll be able to report to you that we'll have a double-digit growth in non-American areas as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects to execute its current order book within the next three to four months.
guidance.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates a robust performance for Q2 and Q3 compared to the record FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: We are looking forward to a robust Q2, Q3 compared to already record FY26, and we hope to continue the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Realisations for lab-grown diamond jewellery are higher than mined diamond jewellery due to the sale of higher caratage items.
demand_outlook.quote: Realisations for LGD jewellery continue to be at a premium to Mined Diamond jewellery for the company due to sales of higher caratage jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Online sales accounted for nearly 20% of the company's revenue in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Online revenue accounted for 19.3% of the revenue during Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's domestic retail brand, ORIGEM, has expanded to 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: ORIGEM, Goldiam’s India retail lab grown diamond jewellery brand, now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam has established manufacturing operations in the United States to produce unfinished jewellery pieces.
capex_expansion.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself, providing employment and job opportunities domestically in the US.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is rapidly scaling its retail footprint for ORIGEM in key urban clusters.
capex_expansion.quote: Rapidly scaling ORIGEM retail footprint across key urban clusters

margins_costs.claim: The steady-state EBITDA margin reached 24% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: The dual-casting method is expected to be employed throughout the full financial year of FY27.
margins_costs.quote: FY27 will be most likely a full financial year where this dual casting method will be employed throughout the year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the first quarter of FY27 grew by over 120% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q1 FY2027 grew by a 120.5% to ₹ 1039 million.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects no material impact on profitability from the recent increase in gold customs duty to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book position as of June 30, 2026, was approximately INR2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book was valued at approximately ₹2,250 million as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on June 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: E-commerce sales are excluded from the order book figures as they are booked on a spot basis.
orders_capacity.quote: E-commerce sales, given their nature of being booked online (on a spot basis), are not part of the order book.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted bonus equity shares in a 1:3 ratio in July 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3 by utilizing an amount of INR7,52,78,562.

capital_allocation.claim: Goldiam holds cash and investments totaling over ₹4.56 billion as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and Cash Equivalents (including investments) were at ₹ 4566.71 million as at June, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has distributed more than ₹2.5 billion to shareholders through buybacks and dividends over the last five years.
capital_allocation.quote: ~₹2.5+bn distributed to shareholders via buyback and dividend over last 5 years

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that ORIGEM recorded an operating loss of INR5-6 crores for the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: There will be approx -- just to give a ballpark figure, it will be in the range between INR5 crores to INR6 crores of operating loss for the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company implemented a US-based casting model to mitigate the impact of steep hikes in US tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted a recent increase in the Basic Customs Duty and cess on gold.
risks_headwinds.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach approximately 100 stores for the ORIGEM brand.
management_commitments.quote: we will be in a great position to reach close to that 100 store figure that we are aiming and targeting to own

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to increase the revenue base significantly over the medium term.
management_commitments.quote: Over the medium term of 3 to 4 years, we hope to strongly increase on that base and deliver -- have a larger company and presence

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to execute its current order book within the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.
